newsitem.title: USA: St. Paul Bancorp files for $100 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: St. Paul Bancorp files for $100 mln notes.

text.p: St. Paul Bancorp Inc said Tuesday it filed a registration with Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $100 million in senior notes due 2004.
The offering will be made through Keefe Bruyette & Woods Inc and the Chicago Corp, the filing said.
Proceeds will be used to repurchase or redeem at par all of the company's outstanding 8.25 percent subordinated notes.
St. Paul, of Chicago, Illinois, is a holding company for St. Paul Federal Bank for Savings.
